conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Brian Carter from the IRS Taxpayer Assistance Center. I'm calling regarding your 2023 tax refund eligibility.
Oh, um, hi. I'm sorry, I'm a little busy right now, can we make this quick? I was just about to pick up my son.
Of course, I'll be brief. Our records indicate you qualify for a $3,200 stimulus refund based on your tax filings. I just need to verify a few details to process your payment today.
Wait, a refund? I didn't expect anything back this year. Is this really the IRS?

Yes, this is the official IRS processing line. Due to increased fraud, we require a one-time identity verification fee before releasing large refunds. This helps protect your account and ensures you get your funds. Do you want to claim your stimulus refund?
I mean, yes, but I've never had to pay to get a refund before. Is this new?

Due to changes in federal tax regulations this year, there is now a $197 clearance fee for all stimulus refunds over $1,500. If you do not pay the fee today, the IRS will have to put your refund on indefinite hold and may notify collections for an audit.
An audit? I don't want that. But I'm not sure if I trust this, can I pay the fee online?

For your security, we only accept verified payment methods. You can use Zelle or Venmo to send the clearance fee directly to the secure IRS refund department. Alternatively, you may purchase Target or Amazon gift cards and provide the code to finalize your verification. If you delay, your file will be flagged for review and potential penalties.
That sounds really serious. I honestly don't want any trouble, but I don't have much time before my next shift. Are you saying I could get fined if I don't pay this now?

Yes, if the clearance fee isn't processed within the next hour, your refund will be canceled and your tax account flagged. This could result in further investigation and fines up to $2,000. I strongly advise you handle this immediately to avoid escalation.
Okay, okay, I can try. I might have some money on Venmo. Who do I send it to?

Excellent. Please send $197 to the Venmo handle @IRS-RefundDept. Once payment is received, I'll confirm your refund processing. Do you need instructions for Venmo, or would you prefer the gift card option?
No, I know how to use Venmo. But can I get a receipt or something? I just want to make sure this is real.

Absolutely. After payment, I will email you an official IRS confirmation letter and your refund tracking number. But remember, if you fail to complete this in the next 30 minutes, I'll be forced to escalate your account for non-compliance. The IRS does not tolerate delays.
I'm doing my best, please don't escalate anything. I can send it now. Can you stay on the line until I finish?

Of course, I'm here to assist, but I cannot hold the refund much longer. Complete the payment to @IRS-RefundDept right away, then read me the confirmation code from your Venmo app. If you hang up or fail to comply, I cannot guarantee your refund or prevent possible penalties.
